name: Slopcore Music Video
tagline: A song full of internet in-jokes goes in, a dense music video with one AI-made star comes out.
description: A music video where one generated character walks through a season of looks, cut on every sung line, while sharp on-screen labels, charts, a countdown and a news ticker explain every joke. Made for songs about a scene's memes, like the AI timeline. Based on how @anabology's viral "Escape Velocity" was made with an agent, Midjourney and a moodboard.
bring: A topic with its own slang (the AI timeline works great)
A song, or lyrics we write together and generate
A moodboard, or a few words about the look you want
Optional: a budget for image and video generation
get: A 16:9 music video, about 2–3 min, every lyric on screen on time

needs.name: Hyperframes, or your project's video tool
An image generator that keeps a character consistent
A music generator, unless you bring a song

steps: Collect the jokes and write or bring the song
Plan one shot per sung line
Build a moodboard and a main character, then review the pictures as a storyboard
Turn the pictures into short clips and cut them to the song
Add the lyrics, labels, charts and countdown on top
Review each version in FrameJam until it's right
